findings.title: Urgent appeal to expedite the entry of winter supplies into Gaza
findings.publisher: UN OCHA OPT / Humanitarian Country Team
findings.location: Gaza Strip; tents staged primarily in Al Arish, Egypt
findings.affected_population_or_system: Displaced families requiring emergency shelter; restricted winter relief and crossing access
findings.supporting_passage: more than 150,000 tents procured by humanitarian partners and Member States are outside Gaza, ready for dispatch
findings.discovery_context: Newly published 13 November HCT statement quantifies at least 150,000 tents awaiting entry outside Gaza, chiefly in Al Arish, and names multiple approval requirements, restricted crossing capacity and delivery windows. Earlier 11 November appeals and 8 November flood impacts were known; the quantified awaiting-delivery figure is new source-grounded detail, not a newly imposed policy or new storm.

findings.title: Palestinian killed by Israeli forces east of Gaza City
findings.publication_time: 09:30, publisher local time; timezone not explicitly specified
findings.location: Al-Tuffah neighborhood, east of Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: One reported Palestinian fatality; civilian status not independently verified
findings.supporting_passage: A Palestinian was killed early Friday morning by Israeli forces' gunfire
findings.discovery_context: WAFA index displayed report dated 13 November at 09:30 local; the prior verified heartbeat had found no Gaza news later than 12 November 22:05 on the same index. Single-agency reporting; no identity, medical confirmation or independent casualty verification in source. Do not combine with previously recorded 12 November toll.

findings.title: WAFA reports separate late-night fatal drone strike near a tent in Al-Mawasi
findings.publication_time: 09:30, publisher local time; timezone not explicitly specified
findings.location: Al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: One reported Palestinian fatality near a tent; civilian status not independently verified
findings.supporting_passage: Another Palestinian was killed late Thursday night
findings.discovery_context: Same 13 November WAFA report distinguishes a late-Thursday Al-Mawasi drone-strike fatality from the Friday al-Tuffah shooting. Incident was not among three 12 November afternoon fatalities reported by WAFA (Al-Shifa, Deir al-Balah, Jabalia). Exact time and independent confirmation unavailable. Avoid asserting this increases any aggregate tally.
